name: patacerta
description: Pet shop e clínica veterinária com assistente de IA contextualizada (RAG)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/ai-service install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/admin install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix apps/api run db:migrate && npm --prefix apps/api run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ai,web,admin -c blue,yellow,green,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/ai-service run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "npm --prefix apps/admin start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/ai-service test && npm --prefix apps/admin test -- --watch=false
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/ai-service run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/admin run build
